draft.subject: Your dashboard vs. export question
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for flagging that your dashboard usage stats don't line up with the monthly export -- your ticket is open with our team and I'm keeping an eye on it with them.

In the meantime, you've got a project up and a teammate in, so you're close to the part where Wrenfield starts paying off day to day. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I can walk through the numbers question with you and help with the next step for your team.

Best,
Nadia
